principle: One record per (contract, document location) link. Verified and candidate links live in separate stores with the same columns, mirroring Silver notice_contract_links / notice_contract_link_candidates. A shared project_id alone never creates a record.

stores.contract_document_link_candidates: verification_status in (candidate, candidate_one_to_many, ambiguous, conflicting, text_reference_only)

fields.name: link_key
fields.note: sha256 of wb_contract_number|document_id|page|row_on_page|match_method

fields.name: wb_contract_number
fields.note: DS00005 contract; legacy DS01004 contract_number in a separate column

fields.name: borrower_contract_reference
fields.note: as published in DS00005

fields.name: contract_reference_normalized
fields.note: wbdisc.normalize.normalize_ref

fields.name: package_reference_core
fields.note: STEP package reference with lot or sequence suffix removed

fields.name: document_id
fields.note: WDS document id

fields.name: document_type
fields.note: PP, PAD, ISR, ICR, ICRR, notice

fields.name: document_version_date
fields.note: WDS document date; plan versions are distinct documents

fields.name: source_url
fields.note: WDS pdfurl (canonical after redirect)

fields.name: document_sha256
fields.note: of the stored PDF

fields.name: section_id
fields.note: plan table section (WORKS, GOODS, NON CONSULTING SERVICES, CONSULTING FIRMS, INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANTS) or document heading path

fields.name: page_number
fields.note: 1-based PDF page

fields.name: evidence_text_sha256
fields.note: hash of the cited cell/row text; text itself stored with the chunk, not here

fields.name: document_reference_text
fields.note: reference as printed in the document, before normalization

fields.name: matching_fields
fields.note: e.g. [project_id, normalized_reference]

fields.name: corroborating_fields
fields.note: category, method, review_type, amount, actual_signing_date

fields.name: independent_corroboration
fields.note: only amount and actual_signing_date count (the reference already encodes category and method)

fields.name: document_values
fields.note: plan method, review, planned/actual dates, amounts as printed

fields.name: structured_values
fields.note: DS00005 values compared

fields.name: date_difference_days
fields.note: plan 'Signed Contract | Actual' minus DS00005 contract_signing_date; planned dates are never compared to actual dates

fields.name: confidence
fields.note: only for attribute_temporal and text_similarity candidates; null for reference-based links

fields.name: reviewed_by
fields.note: manual confirmation; role only, no personal data
